odia: ଋଣ ଶେଷ, ରୋଗ ଶେଷ, ୟାଙ୍କର କେଭେ ନ ରଖିବ ଲେଶ
title: Leaving nothing unfinished
literal_meaning: A remnant of debt, a remnant of illness—never leave a trace of either.
explanation: The paired remnants give the instruction its insistence: a problem left over still demands attention. This is the saying’s absolute rhetoric, not a promise that illness or debt can always be eliminated. Our transfer to unfinished paperwork draws on that insistence without turning the line into medical or financial advice.
meaning_odia: ଋଣ ଓ ରୋଗର ଅବଶେଷକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ି କଥାଟି ଜୋର ଦେଉଛି—ରହିଯାଇଥିବା ସମସ୍ୟା ପୁଣି ଧ୍ୟାନ ମାଗେ। ଏହା କଥାର ନିରଙ୍କୁଶ ଆଦେଶ, ସବୁ ରୋଗ ବା ଋଣ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଦୂର ହେବାର ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ନୁହେଁ। ଅଧାରହିଥିବା କାଗଜକାମରେ ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ସେହି ଜୋରକୁ ନେଉଛି; ଚିକିତ୍ସା ବା ଆର୍ଥିକ ପରାମର୍ଶ ଦେଉନାହିଁ।
english_summary: The paired remnants press for completion; our everyday application is editorial.
odia_summary: ଦୁଇ ଅବଶେଷର ଚିତ୍ର କାମ ସାରିବାର ଜୋର ଆଣେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: A club secretary has filed a report but left its final attachment loose. A colleague quotes the line, then says, “For this report, let us attach the missing page before putting it away.” The scene concerns paperwork, not treatment or repayment decisions.
cultural_context: The headword means complete cure. The verse gives an absolute exhortation; it does not establish causes of illness or blame people with continuing difficulties.
